policies.authority: The design model is authoritative for geometry, materials, openings, storeys and site. A description adds visual intent; it does not create architecture.

status.modeled: Recorded in data/design-lab.json and checkable against the model.
status.inferred: Follows directly from a modeled element (for example, a corner casting on a modeled container) but is not individually authored.
status.conceptual: An illustration placement or intent from the project brief. It is not designed; the caption must say so.
status.not-resolved: A known gap. Do not draw it as a resolved element; record it in the image limitations.

policies.interior: Only Woodland Cottage and Accessible Garden Home have authored interiors. The other four use provisional zone bands. Do not invent partitions, doors, fixtures or room-specific windows for a provisional interior.
policies.furniture: Show only the modeled fixtures listed in the interior schedule. Do not add loose furniture, rugs, lamps, art, plants, books or dishes. An empty room is preferable to an invented one.
policies.finishes: Interior linings, floor finishes, ceiling finishes, joinery and window-frame colours are not documented. Use a neutral pale lining with exposed container steel at reveals and a neutral dark frame; disclose both as illustrative defaults. Do not present a timber species, stain, tile or paint colour as specified.
policies.services: A service element may appear only where the visible-services layer records a modeled or conceptual placement for that image. Elements marked not-resolved or excluded must not appear as resolved. Conceptual placements must be captioned.
policies.claim: No image may claim fire resistance, WUI approval, potable water, water independence, full accessibility, structural capacity or code compliance.
